reviewed.adw-entry-edit: The trailing pencil of <adw-entry-row>. libadwaita ships this glyph itself (refs/libadwaita/src/icons/adw-entry-edit.svg) instead of taking it from the icon theme, so it is in neither /usr/share/icons/Adwaita nor @gjsify/adwaita-icons and cannot be compiled at all. The web draws `document-edit` in its place and carries the canonical name in `data-icon-name` (adw-entry-row.ts, ENTRY_ROW_EDIT_ICON_NAME), so the substitution is legible in the DOM rather than silent.
reviewed.adw-entry-apply: The apply button of an edited <adw-entry-row>. Same origin as adw-entry-edit — a libadwaita-bundled glyph (refs/libadwaita/src/icons/adw-entry-apply.svg), absent from both the icon theme and @gjsify/adwaita-icons. The web button is a text check mark with the canonical name in `data-icon-name` (ENTRY_ROW_APPLY_ICON_NAME); it never reaches <adw-icon>, so there is no mask class to demand.
reviewed.caps-lock: The caps-lock warning of <adw-password-entry-row>. `caps-lock-symbolic` is in neither the Adwaita icon theme nor @gjsify/adwaita-icons' exports, so the web indicator is the text glyph ⇪ with the canonical name in `data-icon-name` (CAPS_LOCK_ICON_NAME, entry-row.ts). Compiling it is not an option that exists; the substitution is recorded at the point of use.
reviewed.view-columns: The third toggle of the toggle-group story and of the buttons doc page. `view-columns-symbolic` is in no icon theme — `find /usr/share/icons/Adwaita -name 'view-columns*'` returns nothing, and it is not among @gjsify/adwaita-icons' exports — so build-scss.mjs hand-draws a 3-column glyph in the symbolic style. THE DIVERGENCE RUNS THE OTHER WAY here: the GTK story (toggle-group.story.ts:31) and the GJS + Blueprint panes of buttons.mdx name it too and get GTK's broken-image paintable, while the web pane draws something only this renderer has. Kept because dropping it would put the web pane's third toggle on image-missing as well — parity bought by making both panes worse. Retire the entry the day adwaita-icons exports the name.
reviewed.view-refresh: The reload button of showcases/dom/minimalist-browser — a shipping surface, so the map entry is earned. The scan cannot see it: that file passes the name to its own `iconButton(icon, tooltip)` helper, which calls `setAttribute('icon', icon)` with a PARAMETER, so no literal sits at a point of use. Retire this entry if the showcase stops naming it, or starts naming it inline.
